messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE (P1) — route=/v1/chat.generate error rate > 8% in us-west-2 for prod - automatic fallback to pinned variant triggered. Pager: @sara (oncall).

sara (oncall): seeing this, joining. Any initial blamestorms or known deploys?

lee (sre): no deploys flagged in the last 10m. Logs show a lot of 500s with payloads that look like chat messages but routed to a model that is an embed/instruct variant.

jordan (runtime): yep—routing service returned compatible=false so fallback policy routed to pinned version 'embed-quant-v2' (pinned by customer pinning config). It can't handle chat/generation requests -> 500s.

tiago (support): we're getting two customer escalations (AcmeCorp, FinServeInc) reporting generation failures and timeouts. Both in us-west-2.

maria (pm): how long has this been up? impact ETA?

lee (sre): spike started ~1778889942 (43s after alert). Error rate peaked at 12% on the route for 7m. Affected requests: gen/chat only; embeddings and rerank unaffected.

sara (oncall): ok immediate plan: 1) stop automatic fallback to pinned variant for chat routes in us-west-2, 2) unpin the model for the customer(s) if pin is global, 3) set temporary route to use non-pinned compatible variant. Jordan, can you flip the routing policy?

jordan (runtime): working on it. Current policy snippet:
```yaml
route: /v1/chat.generate
policy: smart-routing
pin: embed-quant-v2
fallbacks: [compatible-variants, pinned]
region_policy: prefer-local
```

jordan (runtime): I'll change fallbacks to prefer compatible-first and remove 'pinned' from fallback list for that route in us-west-2. Applying change now...

deploy-bot: starting config push to routing-service (change-id: cfg-2023-1778)

deploy-bot: config push successful on us-west-2 (cfg-2023-1778)

jordan (runtime): change applied — fallbacks updated. Observability: dropping 500s now. Continuing to watch.

lee (sre): metrics confirm error rate back to baseline in ~90s after change. Good.

tiago (support): messaging to customers: proactive note saying we detected and mitigated, investigating root cause. Should I open support tickets?

maria (pm): yes please. Mark impacted customers and include timeframe, mitigation, and next steps.

sara (oncall): quick root cause summary we should capture in incident: a customer-level model pin was configured to a variant that only supports embedding/instruct flows. Smart routing attempted to satisfy chat generation by falling back to the pinned variant when the preferred compatible pool was saturated/temporarily unavailable, leading to incompatible request dispatch and 500s.

lee (sre): additional detail — routing decision path showed region-local capacity signals briefly flagged higher latency, so smart-routing considered the pinned variant (global) as a fallback to meet latency SLOs. But we didn't validate API contract compatibility across variants when falling back.

jordan (runtime): here's the snippet from the routing trace for a failing request:
```
trace_id: trc-0a1b2c
route: /v1/chat.generate
preferred_pool: chat-gen-v3 (high-latency)
fallback_chosen: embed-quant-v2 (pinned)
compatibility_check: SKIPPED
error: 500 incompatible model handler
```

sara (oncall): mitigation checklist (done/in progress):
- [x] Disable pinned fallback for chat routes in us-west-2 (jordan)
- [x] Notify affected customers (tiago)
- [x] Throttle traffic away from overloaded local pool to avoid future fallback flaps (lee)
- [ ] Create durable lint/validation to prevent incompatible pins from being used as fallbacks (action)
- [ ] Postmortem and SLA impact calc (owner: sara)

tiago (support): messages sent to AcmeCorp and FinServeInc. AcmeCorp replied: "Thanks — we saw a bunch of failed calls but resumed after ~2m. Can you flag if this will recur?"

maria (pm): need to know customer-visible downtime window for SLA reporting. Lee, can you provide totals?

lee (sre): Affected window: 1778889942 -> 1778890060 (118s) for severe errors, lingering latency impact until 1778890200. I'll calculate exact p50/p95/p99 token-level failures and send to postmortem doc.

sara (oncall): handing off to lee (next-oncall) for full incident write-up and postmortem. I'll remain available for context. Paging next-oncall: @lee (sre) you're up.

lee (sre): taking ownership. Immediate follow-ups I will own:
- Incident timeline and SLA calc
- Action item: add compatibility checks in fallback selection (routing-service)
- Action item: add guard in pin API to warn/deny pins that mismatch route type (e.g., embedding-only models pinned on chat routes)
- Action item: add telemetry alert for fallback-to-pinned events (so we page before user-visible errors)

jordan (runtime): I can land a short-term check in routing-service to validate model schema compatibility before choosing pinned fallback (will be a fast fail to avoid 500s). Timeline: patch in next 2h, can be hotfixed to prod.

deploy-bot: hotfix deployment started (patch-id: rt-compat-check-2023)

deploy-bot: hotfix deployed to us-west-2 (rt-compat-check-2023)

lee (sre): nice. Long-term we'll add the pin API guard and UI warning in Console. Maria, pls prioritize in roadmap.

maria (pm): adding as P0 for the next sprint; will sync with growth/console team for UX.

sara (oncall): final notes: this incident highlights a gap in cross-checking variant capability at both pin-time and routing-time. Thanks everyone for the fast mitigation. I'll file a short incident summary and link the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

lee (sre): incident closed for now, moving to postmortem. Logging follow-ups in the incidents tracker.

incident-bot: incident state changed to RESOLVED by lee (sre) at 1778891300
